lead: A test you are about to write may already have its name fixed by `loop-goal.toml`, and the handoff item will not carry it.
body: A gate written to the item alone lands under a fourth name and leaves the stage red with everything implemented; the fixed names are also a design, since three names say what is asserted separately. Before writing a new test for a goal item, `grep -n -A8 'stage = "<the stage>"' docs/agent/loop-goal.toml` and take the names from the `tests = [` block.
